title: $0 - $3,000,000 - My Affiliate Marketing Journey
description: Here is the story of my Affiliate Marketing Journey, and how I went from $0 to $3,000,000.  If you want to build a real system that works FOR YOUR, and helps create a new income source, you can get started by clicking the link below to my course! -----   Learn how to start a $10,000/month Agency:  https://smma.buildapreneur.com/ai  Join the Hustlers Club (FREE) and discover the hustles I find before anyone else:  https://smma.buildapreneur.com/side-hustle  Start Affiliate Marketing (Easiest Beginner Business): https://smma.buildapreneur.com/affiliate-marketing  Training: How I build a $10,000/month affiliate business in 2 years: https://buildapreneur.com/webinar  Join the 15-day business builder challenge: https://buildapreneur.com/recommends/legendary-marketer/yt  My favorite course builder: https://buildapreneur.com/recommends/thinkific/yt  All Spencer's courses: https://go.buildapreneur.com/single-courses-main-page  My recommended email software: https://buildapreneur.com/recommends/active-campaign/yt  My recommended Website/Landing page builder https://buildapreneur.com/recommends/clickfunnels/yt  -----   5 years ago, I had no idea what Affiliate Marketing even was...  Today, I've just recently passed over $3,000,000 in commissions from just ONE of the products that I have successfully promoted over the last few years.  In this video, I'll be sharing my story, and how I went from working a normal 9 to 5 job with my wife, to desperately needing to replace some income as we prepared to become parents.  By learning a few major key points, such as content creation and system automation, which you can learn in my course using the link above, I was able to go from nothing to $1,000,000 in commissions in just under 2 years.  From then on, I've gone on to make even more from that, without spending nearly as much money, thanks to my Automation Systems, which you can learn by being a part of my Automation Nation Facebook Group.  Affiliate Marketing truly has changed my life, and I hope to share that experience and the tools with you to help you do the same in your life.  If you ever have any questions, please feel free to leave a comment!  I love helping my community and audience out with any Affiliate Marketing, and will always make it a priority to get your questions answered.
